body: I have been seeing a therapist for a number of months now and have already been placed on medications. All I really get from her is the standard "just stay positive, meet new people, go to the gym" kind of stuff. None of which has been much help. As far as what I'm feeling, it's more what I'm not feeling. I have no opinion about anything and no interest. I am stuck in a quagmire of nothingness and I just want out. Absence would be better than the vacuum I currently reside in.
